code:
Grover's on N = 2^n items needs
approx (pi/4)*sqrt(N) iterations.

n=10 qubits, N=1024 items:
iterations = (pi/4)*sqrt(1024)
           = (pi/4)*32
           = 25.13 -> plan for 25

25 calls * 40 2-qubit gates/call
  = ~1000 2-qubit-gate-equivalents
caption: A number worth checking against your target backend's realistic noise-tolerant depth before submission, not after a failed run.

eyebrow: Worked example: shot budget for training
code:
QAOA, p=3 layers -> 2p=6 params
parameter-shift: 2 evals/param
evals/gradient = 6*2 = 12

100 iterations, 2000 shots/eval:
total_execs = 12*100 = 1,200
total_shots = 1,200*2,000
            = 2,400,000
caption: 2.4 million total shots is the number that actually determines queue cost — not "one circuit, 2000 shots."
